test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following locations is correct for installing the oil filter in the engine?

options.text: In between coolers and the oil lines coming from sump
After lines going to supply the oil to the bearing after coolers
Downstream of coolers in order to filter if any solid part from coolers enters the oil lines
Up stream of coolers in order to filter if any solid part from coolers lives the oil lines

solution:
The correct answer is __Downstream of coolers in order to filter if any solid part from coolers enters the oil lines__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Oil filters__ are critical components in an engine's lubrication system.
 
• They are placed strategically to remove impurities from the oil before it circulates through the engine.
 
• Installing the filter downstream of the coolers ensures any solid contaminants from the coolers are caught before entering the oil lines.
 
• This placement helps in maintaining optimum engine performance and longevity.
 
• Proper filtration is vital to prevent damage to engine components.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Upstream Placement:**

 
 
• This placement filters oil before it enters the coolers.
 
• Ensures clean oil flows through the cooling system but doesn’t protect oil lines from cooler debris.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Oil Filters:**
 
 
• They prevent contaminants from causing engine wear.
 
• 
• Ensure the lubrication system functions smoothly by maintaining oil purity.
 
• 
• Critical for reducing engine maintenance costs and extending the lifespan of components.
